svg.aria-label: Why kiit. Standards: Claude Code gives you CLAUDE.md in each repo. kiit adds Shared engineering standards, Branch and PR format defaults, Your overrides in kiit.json. Skill groups: Claude Code gives you Skills and plugins. kiit adds Groups: vcs and flow so far, A help command for each group, Shared parts live in core. Multiple repos: Claude Code gives you The folder you start in and --add-dir. kiit adds One workspace config, A ticket system per project, Same standards in every repo.
